items.question: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
items.answer:
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90 per month for the Get Clássica versus R$ 129.90 for the Get Smart, and the rental waiver starts at R$ 10 thousand of monthly sales for the Get Clássica versus R$ 60 thousand for the Get Smart.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: Get Clássica R$ 79.90 per month (for comparison: Get Mini R$ 14.90, Get Smart R$ 129.90, selling by phone R$ 0.00). Rental is waived for the Get Clássica with sales of R$ 10 thousand per month.
All Getnet card machines (todas as maquininhas): Rental without minimum sales: Get Clássica R$ 79.90 per month, Get Smart R$ 129.90 per month, selling by phone free. This page states rental-waiver thresholds of R$ 20 thousand per month for the Get Clássica and R$ 40 thousand or R$ 80 thousand per month for the Get Smart; these differ from the thresholds on the individual product pages (R$ 10 thousand and R$ 60 thousand), so the applicable threshold should be confirmed in the simulator or with Getnet.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/todas-as-maquininhas/

items.question: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
items.answer:
Pix with Getnet: The Pix page does not say whether a bank account or a Getnet digital account is required to receive Pix sales, does not describe an activation process, and does not publish Pix fees. See the Get Conta digital account page for where sales can be received. Per the FAQ, Pix allows up to 5 keys (chaves) per account for individuals and 20 for companies.
Get Conta, the Getnet digital account (conta digital): Get Conta is Getnet's digital account, promoted as "digital account and free card" (conta digital e cartão grátis) together with the card machines. It lets a merchant receive all payments in the same account, control the operation from the account, use a free virtual card, and access receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis).
Pix with Getnet: There is no single fixed deadline: the time to receive a Pix sale can vary by up to one calendar day (até um dia corrido), depending on the Pix model the customer is eligible for and the time the sale is approved. The site markets Pix as receiving sales "in seconds".

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/, https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/

items.question: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
items.answer:
Card machine POS-GS-99812 (Get Smart): connectivity status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT; mobile data: Dual-SIM 4G session stalled; Wi-Fi: Wi-Fi interface disabled.

Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT means the terminal's mobile data session stalled. First-line steps for the merchant, in order: 1) restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator; 2) if Wi-Fi is available, connect the terminal to the store Wi-Fi; 3) with the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip and power it back on; 4) run the communication test described in the Getnet FAQ. If the terminal is still offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after these steps, open a ticket with a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.

Sources: internal://support-runbook, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
items.answer:
Receivables advance (antecipação de vendas / recebíveis): The Getnet help page "Antecipação de vendas" contains only a video section with tips; it does not publish in text the definition, modalities, deadlines, fees, eligible sales or cut-off times for receivables advance (antecipação). What other pages state: receivables advance is one of the functions of the Get Conta digital account; the FAQ fee tables show plans with settlement in 2 business days or "receive as you sell" (Receba conforme suas vendas); and without an advance, merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista) pay the first installment at D+31 and each following one 30 days later. Conditions and rates for a specific merchant must be simulated in the Getnet app or Portal Minha Conta, or confirmed with Getnet support (4002-4000 / 4003-4000 in capitals and metropolitan regions, 0800-648-8000 elsewhere, 06h00 to 22h00).
Get Conta, the Getnet digital account (conta digital): Get Conta is Getnet's digital account, promoted as "digital account and free card" (conta digital e cartão grátis) together with the card machines. It lets a merchant receive all payments in the same account, control the operation from the account, use a free virtual card, and access receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis).
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): The Algar chip is multi-carrier, works on 2G/3G coverage across Brazil and avoids chip swaps.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/, https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

items.question: My card machine is showing a transaction decline error.
items.answer:
Last declined transaction on POS-GS-99812: TX-88410 (R$ 430.00), code ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN. Reason: Recurring terminal cryptographic PIN-pad key desynchronization requiring L2 remote re-keying or terminal swap.

Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE alone is an issuer-side refusal: ask the buyer to try another card or contact their bank. When it appears together with POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN, the terminal's PIN-pad keys are out of sync; this cannot be fixed by the merchant and requires a remote re-key or terminal swap (action code terminal_rekey_or_swap), which must be approved by a human L2 specialist before it is scheduled.

A human specialist reviewed ticket TKT-261116-55B1A3 and approved the action. Service order SO-BE38BB9A was created for terminal_rekey_or_swap. Operator note: "Remote re-key scheduled for today."

Sources: internal://support-runbook

items.question: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
items.answer:
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): With Crediário a sale can be split into up to 48 installments (parcelamento em até 48x). The maximum term and the interest rate of the installment plan vary according to the card issuer (emissor do cartão).
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Issuer installments (Parcelado Emissor): received at once, between 2 and 31 days depending on the plan, up to 24 installments. Merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista): first installment at D+31 and the others 30 days after the previous one, up to 12 installments.
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): The merchant receives Crediário sales in up to 2 business days (2 dias úteis) after the transaction is captured, in a single payment (de uma única vez) regardless of the number of installments, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

items.question: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
items.answer:
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): Yes: the Payment Link is made for selling through WhatsApp or social networks ("Faça vendas usando o WhatsApp ou sua rede social"), without a card machine (sem maquininha). The merchant creates a link and shares or copies it to the customer.
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): Create it in Portal Minha Conta (login and password) or in the Getnet Brasil app: Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento. Fill in the product data, shipping (frete) and payment options, then share or copy the link.
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): Plans: Inicial is free and charges R$ 1.00 per paid link, only when the payment is approved; Básico costs R$ 28 per month, includes 60 card transactions per month and charges R$ 0.50 per extra transaction. The page gives no standard settlement deadline for the link; the FAQ says D+2 settlement for the payment link becomes available after 6 months of use, subject to analysis.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

items.question: When will the money from yesterday's sales be deposited?
items.answer:
I can only show account data (settlements, card machine status, tickets) to a signed-in merchant. Please sign in and ask again.

Get Smart card machine (maquininha): With Get Conta, sales are received in 2 business days.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Sales are received in 2 business days (2 dias úteis) with Get Conta, the free Getnet digital account and card.
Pix with Getnet: There is no single fixed deadline: the time to receive a Pix sale can vary by up to one calendar day (até um dia corrido), depending on the Pix model the customer is eligible for and the time the sale is approved. The site markets Pix as receiving sales "in seconds".

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

items.question: It is still offline after I restarted it. What else can I try?
items.answer:
Card machine POS-GS-99812 (Get Smart): connectivity status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT; mobile data: Dual-SIM 4G session stalled; Wi-Fi: Wi-Fi interface disabled.

Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT means the terminal's mobile data session stalled. First-line steps for the merchant, in order: 1) restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator; 2) if Wi-Fi is available, connect the terminal to the store Wi-Fi; 3) with the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip and power it back on; 4) run the communication test described in the Getnet FAQ. If the terminal is still offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after these steps, open a ticket with a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.

Sources: internal://support-runbook, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: And when do I receive the money from those sales?
items.answer:
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): The merchant receives Crediário sales in up to 2 business days (2 dias úteis) after the transaction is captured, in a single payment (de uma única vez) regardless of the number of installments, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): With Crediário a sale can be split into up to 48 installments (parcelamento em até 48x). The maximum term and the interest rate of the installment plan vary according to the card issuer (emissor do cartão).
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Issuer installments (Parcelado Emissor): received at once, between 2 and 31 days depending on the plan, up to 24 installments. Merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista): first installment at D+31 and the others 30 days after the previous one, up to 12 installments.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

items.question: My card machine is showing a transaction decline error.
items.answer:
Last declined transaction on POS-GS-99812: TX-88410 (R$ 430.00), code ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN. Reason: Recurring terminal cryptographic PIN-pad key desynchronization requiring L2 remote re-keying or terminal swap.

Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE alone is an issuer-side refusal: ask the buyer to try another card or contact their bank. When it appears together with POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN, the terminal's PIN-pad keys are out of sync; this cannot be fixed by the merchant and requires a remote re-key or terminal swap (action code terminal_rekey_or_swap), which must be approved by a human L2 specialist before it is scheduled.

A human specialist reviewed ticket TKT-261116-66016C and did not approve the action. Nothing was changed. Operator note: "Not approved yet: please ask the buyer to try a different card first."

Sources: internal://support-runbook

items.question: ¿Cuántas cuotas permite el crediário de Getnet?
items.answer:
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): With Crediário a sale can be split into up to 48 installments (parcelamento em até 48x). The maximum term and the interest rate of the installment plan vary according to the card issuer (emissor do cartão).
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): The merchant receives Crediário sales in up to 2 business days (2 dias úteis) after the transaction is captured, in a single payment (de uma única vez) regardless of the number of installments, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Issuer installments (Parcelado Emissor): received at once, between 2 and 31 days depending on the plan, up to 24 installments. Merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista): first installment at D+31 and the others 30 days after the previous one, up to 12 installments.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

items.question: What plans does the Payment Link have and how much do they cost?
items.answer:
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): The page does not state a maximum number of card installments for the link. Plans: Inicial is free and charges R$ 1.00 per paid link, only when the payment is approved; Básico costs R$ 28 per month, includes 60 card transactions per month and charges R$ 0.50 per extra transaction. The page gives no standard settlement deadline for the link; the FAQ says D+2 settlement for the payment link becomes available after 6 months of use, subject to analysis.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

items.question: What is the debit rate on the Get Clássica?
items.answer:
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Published "from" rates (a partir de) with a single rate (taxa única) for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex: debit (débito) 1.69%; credit in one payment (crédito à vista, 1x) 3.79%; installment credit (crédito parcelado) 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. The page does not publish a Pix rate for this model.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Sales are received in 2 business days (2 dias úteis) with Get Conta, the free Getnet digital account and card. For prepaid cards: credit in up to 2 business days and debit in up to 1 business day.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Both are POS machines with 3G + Wi-Fi sold with the same published card rates (debit 1.69%, installments 2x to 12x from 7.98% to 12.88%). The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.question: How many Pix keys can a company have?
items.answer:
Pix with Getnet: The Pix page does not say whether a bank account or a Getnet digital account is required to receive Pix sales, does not describe an activation process, and does not publish Pix fees. Per the FAQ, Pix allows up to 5 keys (chaves) per account for individuals and 20 for companies.
Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): When it appears together with POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN, the terminal's PIN-pad keys are out of sync; this cannot be fixed by the merchant and requires a remote re-key or terminal swap (action code terminal_rekey_or_swap), which must be approved by a human L2 specialist before it is scheduled. Until then the merchant can keep selling with Pix or a Payment Link.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/, internal://support-runbook

items.answer:
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Phone for capitals and metropolitan regions: 4002-4000 or 4003-4000. Customer service hours: 06h to 22h. Self-service: Portal Minha Conta and the Getnet Brasil app.
Receivables advance (antecipação de vendas / recebíveis): The Getnet help page "Antecipação de vendas" contains only a video section with tips; it does not publish in text the definition, modalities, deadlines, fees, eligible sales or cut-off times for receivables advance (antecipação). Conditions and rates for a specific merchant must be simulated in the Getnet app or Portal Minha Conta, or confirmed with Getnet support (4002-4000 / 4003-4000 in capitals and metropolitan regions, 0800-648-8000 elsewhere, 06h00 to 22h00).

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

items.question: What is the battery capacity of the Get Smart in mAh?
items.answer:
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The Get Smart is presented as a "5 in 1" machine: payment terminal, barcode reader (leitor de código de barras), camera, fiscal-receipt printer (impressora) and an integrated management system (sistema de gestão). Operating system, screen size and battery specifications are only in an image on the page, not in text.
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Get Smart battery: charge for at least 3 hours in a row and when it reaches 20%; do not let it fully discharge. Paying with QR Code on the Get Smart: select the debit option.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi. The page's technical sheet is an image, so keyboard, screen, printer and battery details are not available as text on the page.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: What is the rate for credit in one payment on the Get Smart?
items.answer:
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Rates "from" (a partir de), single rate for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex, valid for sales received in Get Conta: debit 1.69%; installment credit 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. For credit in one payment (1x) the page shows 3.69% in one section and 3.79% in another and does not clarify which applies. No Pix rate is published for this model.
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Published terms: with the 2-business-day plan the debit rate is 1.89% and credit in one payment 3.99%; with the "Receba conforme suas vendas" plan debit is 1.95% and credit in one payment 3.09%. Online store (Loja Digital): credit in one payment 2.80% + R$ 0.90 per transaction, received in 31 days.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Published "from" rates (a partir de) with a single rate (taxa única) for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex: debit (débito) 1.69%; credit in one payment (crédito à vista, 1x) 3.79%; installment credit (crédito parcelado) 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. The page does not publish a Pix rate for this model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.answer:

items.question: On the Get Smart, why would a second identical sale be cancelled automatically?
items.answer:
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): It documents: on the Get Smart, two identical sales (same card, brand and amount) within 5 minutes cause the second to be cancelled automatically, so wait 5 minutes or use a different amount; cancelling sales from previous days on the Get Smart is done only by phone, 4003-4000. Card-not-present sales can be cancelled even if the merchant proves the transaction.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: R$ 129.90. By monthly sales: from R$ 10 thousand the rental is R$ 50.00; from R$ 30 thousand it is R$ 10.00; from R$ 60 thousand the Get Smart is free.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90 per month for the Get Clássica versus R$ 129.90 for the Get Smart, and the rental waiver starts at R$ 10 thousand of monthly sales for the Get Clássica versus R$ 60 thousand for the Get Smart.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.question: What Pix fee does Getnet charge on the Get Clássica?
items.answer:
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Published "from" rates (a partir de) with a single rate (taxa única) for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex: debit (débito) 1.69%; credit in one payment (crédito à vista, 1x) 3.79%; installment credit (crédito parcelado) 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. The page does not publish a Pix rate for this model.
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): The buyer can pay by debit, credit, Pix, wallet or boleto. Plans: Inicial is free and charges R$ 1.00 per paid link, only when the payment is approved; Básico costs R$ 28 per month, includes 60 card transactions per month and charges R$ 0.50 per extra transaction.
Pix with Getnet: The Pix page does not say whether a bank account or a Getnet digital account is required to receive Pix sales, does not describe an activation process, and does not publish Pix fees. Its only advice is to keep registration data with Getnet up to date.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/, https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/

items.question: Which bank account do my sales get deposited into?
items.answer:
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Sales are received in 2 business days (2 dias úteis) with Get Conta, the free Getnet digital account and card.
Pix with Getnet: The Pix page does not say whether a bank account or a Getnet digital account is required to receive Pix sales, does not describe an activation process, and does not publish Pix fees. See the Get Conta digital account page for where sales can be received.
Get Conta, the Getnet digital account (conta digital): The account is opened by choosing a machine or another product (maquininhas, link de pagamento or Get Tap) on the site, by WhatsApp (11 97694-6815) or by phone. The page does not state whether an account at another bank is also required; it only says payments can be received in Get Conta itself.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/pix/, https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/

items.question: And from what monthly sales volume is that rental waived?
items.answer:
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: Get Clássica R$ 79.90 per month (for comparison: Get Mini R$ 14.90, Get Smart R$ 129.90, selling by phone R$ 0.00). Rental is waived for the Get Clássica with sales of R$ 10 thousand per month. Voucher (VA/VR) and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90 per month for the Get Clássica versus R$ 129.90 for the Get Smart, and the rental waiver starts at R$ 10 thousand of monthly sales for the Get Clássica versus R$ 60 thousand for the Get Smart.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: R$ 129.90. By monthly sales: from R$ 10 thousand the rental is R$ 50.00; from R$ 30 thousand it is R$ 10.00; from R$ 60 thousand the Get Smart is free.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.question: From what monthly sales volume is the Get Smart rental free?
items.answer:
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: R$ 129.90. By monthly sales: from R$ 10 thousand the rental is R$ 50.00; from R$ 30 thousand it is R$ 10.00; from R$ 60 thousand the Get Smart is free. Voucher (VA/VR) and Crediário sales do not count toward the waiver.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: Get Clássica R$ 79.90 per month (for comparison: Get Mini R$ 14.90, Get Smart R$ 129.90, selling by phone R$ 0.00). Rental is waived for the Get Clássica with sales of R$ 10 thousand per month.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90 per month for the Get Clássica versus R$ 129.90 for the Get Smart, and the rental waiver starts at R$ 10 thousand of monthly sales for the Get Clássica versus R$ 60 thousand for the Get Smart.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: Quantas transações estão incluídas no plano Básico do Link de Pagamento?
items.answer:
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): The page does not state a maximum number of card installments for the link. Plans: Inicial is free and charges R$ 1.00 per paid link, only when the payment is approved; Básico costs R$ 28 per month, includes 60 card transactions per month and charges R$ 0.50 per extra transaction. The page gives no standard settlement deadline for the link; the FAQ says D+2 settlement for the payment link becomes available after 6 months of use, subject to analysis.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

items.question: Is receivables advance active on my account, and how many installments does the crediário allow?
items.answer:
Receivables advance (antecipação de vendas / recebíveis): The Getnet help page "Antecipação de vendas" contains only a video section with tips; it does not publish in text the definition, modalities, deadlines, fees, eligible sales or cut-off times for receivables advance (antecipação). What other pages state: receivables advance is one of the functions of the Get Conta digital account; the FAQ fee tables show plans with settlement in 2 business days or "receive as you sell" (Receba conforme suas vendas); and without an advance, merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista) pay the first installment at D+31 and each following one 30 days later.
Get Conta, the Getnet digital account (conta digital): Get Conta is Getnet's digital account, promoted as "digital account and free card" (conta digital e cartão grátis) together with the card machines. It lets a merchant receive all payments in the same account, control the operation from the account, use a free virtual card, and access receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis).

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/, https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/

items.question: What is the monthly rental of the Get Mini?
items.answer:
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: Get Clássica R$ 79.90 per month (for comparison: Get Mini R$ 14.90, Get Smart R$ 129.90, selling by phone R$ 0.00). Rental is waived for the Get Clássica with sales of R$ 10 thousand per month. Voucher (VA/VR) and Crediário sales do not count toward the rental waiver.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: R$ 129.90. By monthly sales: from R$ 10 thousand the rental is R$ 50.00; from R$ 30 thousand it is R$ 10.00; from R$ 60 thousand the Get Smart is free.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90 per month for the Get Clássica versus R$ 129.90 for the Get Smart, and the rental waiver starts at R$ 10 thousand of monthly sales for the Get Clássica versus R$ 60 thousand for the Get Smart.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.question: Qual é a taxa de débito no plano Receba conforme suas vendas?
items.answer:
Receivables advance (antecipação de vendas / recebíveis): The Getnet help page "Antecipação de vendas" contains only a video section with tips; it does not publish in text the definition, modalities, deadlines, fees, eligible sales or cut-off times for receivables advance (antecipação). What other pages state: receivables advance is one of the functions of the Get Conta digital account; the FAQ fee tables show plans with settlement in 2 business days or "receive as you sell" (Receba conforme suas vendas); and without an advance, merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista) pay the first installment at D+31 and each following one 30 days later. Conditions and rates for a specific merchant must be simulated in the Getnet app or Portal Minha Conta, or confirmed with Getnet support (4002-4000 / 4003-4000 in capitals and metropolitan regions, 0800-648-8000 elsewhere, 06h00 to 22h00).
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Published terms: with the 2-business-day plan the debit rate is 1.89% and credit in one payment 3.99%; with the "Receba conforme suas vendas" plan debit is 1.95% and credit in one payment 3.09%.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/

items.question: How many devices can I use in one store with the Get Smart?
items.answer:
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Get Smart gives access to GetStore, with more than 150 solutions such as cashback, giftback, stock control (controle de estoque) and management systems. Other features: Kiosk mode (Modo Quiosque: one app at a time, screen always on, password protected, suitable for self-service totems); POS TEF Digital (works as a TEF solution integrated with checkout automation); physical split and marketplace for companies, with commission and tip modules where the split happens at transaction time; up to 5 devices can be used in one store (Multi-Equipamentos).
Get Conta, the Getnet digital account (conta digital): Get Conta is Getnet's digital account, promoted as "digital account and free card" (conta digital e cartão grátis) together with the card machines. It lets a merchant receive all payments in the same account, control the operation from the account, use a free virtual card, and access receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis).
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90 per month for the Get Clássica versus R$ 129.90 for the Get Smart, and the rental waiver starts at R$ 10 thousand of monthly sales for the Get Clássica versus R$ 60 thousand for the Get Smart.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/

items.question: What is the Getnet ombudsman phone number and when is it open?
items.answer:
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Phone for capitals and metropolitan regions: 4002-4000 or 4003-4000. Ombudsman (Ouvidoria): 0800 646 3404, Monday to Friday 9h15 to 17h30 except holidays. Self-service: Portal Minha Conta and the Getnet Brasil app.
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): The merchant receives Crediário sales in up to 2 business days (2 dias úteis) after the transaction is captured, in a single payment (de uma única vez) regardless of the number of installments, net of the discount rate.
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): The page does not state a maximum number of card installments for the link.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/, https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/

items.question: What is the monthly maintenance fee of Get Conta?
items.answer:
Get Conta, the Getnet digital account (conta digital): Get Conta is Getnet's digital account, promoted as "digital account and free card" (conta digital e cartão grátis) together with the card machines. The page publishes no maintenance fee.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Rates "from" (a partir de), single rate for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex, valid for sales received in Get Conta: debit 1.69%; installment credit 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. No Pix rate is published for this model.
Receivables advance (antecipação de vendas / recebíveis): What other pages state: receivables advance is one of the functions of the Get Conta digital account; the FAQ fee tables show plans with settlement in 2 business days or "receive as you sell" (Receba conforme suas vendas); and without an advance, merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista) pay the first installment at D+31 and each following one 30 days later. Conditions and rates for a specific merchant must be simulated in the Getnet app or Portal Minha Conta, or confirmed with Getnet support (4002-4000 / 4003-4000 in capitals and metropolitan regions, 0800-648-8000 elsewhere, 06h00 to 22h00).

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/conta-digital/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/

items.question: What is the maximum number of card installments on a Payment Link?
items.answer:
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): The page does not state a maximum number of card installments for the link. Plans: Inicial is free and charges R$ 1.00 per paid link, only when the payment is approved; Básico costs R$ 28 per month, includes 60 card transactions per month and charges R$ 0.50 per extra transaction. The page gives no standard settlement deadline for the link; the FAQ says D+2 settlement for the payment link becomes available after 6 months of use, subject to analysis.
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): The merchant receives Crediário sales in up to 2 business days (2 dias úteis) after the transaction is captured, in a single payment (de uma única vez) regardless of the number of installments, net of the discount rate. Crediário sales do not count toward the card machine rental waiver.
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): With Crediário a sale can be split into up to 48 installments (parcelamento em até 48x). The maximum term and the interest rate of the installment plan vary according to the card issuer (emissor do cartão).

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/, https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/

items.question: Does the Get Clássica work over Wi-Fi?
items.answer:
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Both are POS machines with 3G + Wi-Fi sold with the same published card rates (debit 1.69%, installments 2x to 12x from 7.98% to 12.88%). The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The Get Smart is presented as a "5 in 1" machine: payment terminal, barcode reader (leitor de código de barras), camera, fiscal-receipt printer (impressora) and an integrated management system (sistema de gestão). The site labels it "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi" (3G and Wi-Fi connectivity).

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.question: Which payment methods can a buyer use on a Payment Link?
items.answer:
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): The buyer can pay by debit, credit, Pix, wallet or boleto. Plans: Inicial is free and charges R$ 1.00 per paid link, only when the payment is approved; Básico costs R$ 28 per month, includes 60 card transactions per month and charges R$ 0.50 per extra transaction. The page gives no standard settlement deadline for the link; the FAQ says D+2 settlement for the payment link becomes available after 6 months of use, subject to analysis.
Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE alone is an issuer-side refusal: ask the buyer to try another card or contact their bank. Until then the merchant can keep selling with Pix or a Payment Link.
Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento): Create it in Portal Minha Conta (login and password) or in the Getnet Brasil app: Produtos e Serviços > Link de Pagamento > Criar Link de Pagamento. Fill in the product data, shipping (frete) and payment options, then share or copy the link.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/, internal://support-runbook

items.question: How do I cancel a sale from a previous day on the Get Smart?
items.answer:
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): It documents: on the Get Smart, two identical sales (same card, brand and amount) within 5 minutes cause the second to be cancelled automatically, so wait 5 minutes or use a different amount; cancelling sales from previous days on the Get Smart is done only by phone, 4003-4000. A chargeback (contestação de venda) is when the bank cancels a transaction and debits the merchant, for example for goods not received or defective, a transaction not recognized by the cardholder, duplicate processing, a refund not processed, or payment by another means. Card-not-present sales can be cancelled even if the merchant proves the transaction.
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Published terms: with the 2-business-day plan the debit rate is 1.89% and credit in one payment 3.99%; with the "Receba conforme suas vendas" plan debit is 1.95% and credit in one payment 3.09%. With Get Conta, payment arrives in up to 2 business days, in the morning, when that option is chosen.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): With Get Conta, sales are received in 2 business days. Prepaid cards: credit in up to 2 business days, debit in up to 1 business day.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/

items.question: What is the rate for credit in one payment in the online store, and when is it received?
items.answer:
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Published terms: with the 2-business-day plan the debit rate is 1.89% and credit in one payment 3.99%; with the "Receba conforme suas vendas" plan debit is 1.95% and credit in one payment 3.09%. With Get Conta, payment arrives in up to 2 business days, in the morning, when that option is chosen. Online store (Loja Digital): credit in one payment 2.80% + R$ 0.90 per transaction, received in 31 days.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): Rates "from" (a partir de), single rate for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex, valid for sales received in Get Conta: debit 1.69%; installment credit 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. For credit in one payment (1x) the page shows 3.69% in one section and 3.79% in another and does not clarify which applies.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Published "from" rates (a partir de) with a single rate (taxa única) for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex: debit (débito) 1.69%; credit in one payment (crédito à vista, 1x) 3.79%; installment credit (crédito parcelado) 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. The page does not publish a Pix rate for this model.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: Minha maquininha está online?
items.answer:
Card machine POS-GS-99812 (Get Smart): connectivity status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT; mobile data: Dual-SIM 4G session stalled; Wi-Fi: Wi-Fi interface disabled.
Last declined transaction on POS-GS-99812: TX-88410 (R$ 430.00), code ERR_51_ISSUER_DECLINE / POS_KEY_SYNC_WARN. Reason: Recurring terminal cryptographic PIN-pad key desynchronization requiring L2 remote re-keying or terminal swap.

Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT means the terminal's mobile data session stalled. First-line steps for the merchant, in order: 1) restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator; 2) if Wi-Fi is available, connect the terminal to the store Wi-Fi; 3) with the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip and power it back on; 4) run the communication test described in the Getnet FAQ. If the terminal is still offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after these steps, open a ticket with a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.

Sources: internal://support-runbook, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: What is my terminal's connectivity status right now, and how long should I charge the Get Smart battery?
items.answer:
Card machine POS-GS-99812 (Get Smart): connectivity status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT; mobile data: Dual-SIM 4G session stalled; Wi-Fi: Wi-Fi interface disabled.

Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT means the terminal's mobile data session stalled. First-line steps for the merchant, in order: 1) restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator; 2) if Wi-Fi is available, connect the terminal to the store Wi-Fi; 3) with the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip and power it back on; 4) run the communication test described in the Getnet FAQ. If the terminal is still offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after these steps, open a ticket with a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.

Sources: internal://support-runbook, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: And for credit in 6 installments?
items.answer:
Crediário Getnet (installment credit financed by the card issuer): With Crediário a sale can be split into up to 48 installments (parcelamento em até 48x). The maximum term and the interest rate of the installment plan vary according to the card issuer (emissor do cartão).
Getnet FAQ (dúvidas frequentes): Issuer installments (Parcelado Emissor): received at once, between 2 and 31 days depending on the plan, up to 24 installments. Merchant installments (Parcelado Lojista): first installment at D+31 and the others 30 days after the previous one, up to 12 installments.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Published "from" rates (a partir de) with a single rate (taxa única) for Mastercard, Visa, Elo and Amex: debit (débito) 1.69%; credit in one payment (crédito à vista, 1x) 3.79%; installment credit (crédito parcelado) 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96%, 5x 9.45%, 6x 9.94%, 7x 10.43%, 8x 10.92%, 9x 11.41%, 10x 11.90%, 11x 12.39%, 12x 12.88%. Card installments on the machine go from 1x to 12x.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/crediario/, https://site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/

items.question: Qual é o preço de compra da Get Clássica?
items.answer:
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): Monthly rental if the minimum sales volume is not reached: Get Clássica R$ 79.90 per month (for comparison: Get Mini R$ 14.90, Get Smart R$ 129.90, selling by phone R$ 0.00). Rental is waived for the Get Clássica with sales of R$ 10 thousand per month.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.
Get Smart card machine (maquininha): The differences the site documents: the Get Smart is a 5-in-1 smart device (payment terminal, barcode reader, camera, printer and management system) with GetStore apps (150+ solutions), Kiosk mode, POS TEF Digital and split payments, while the Get Clássica is the classic POS machine without those app features. Rental without minimum volume is R$ 79.90 per month for the Get Clássica versus R$ 129.90 for the Get Smart, and the rental waiver starts at R$ 10 thousand of monthly sales for the Get Clássica versus R$ 60 thousand for the Get Smart.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-smart/
